title: the Kuiper Line Rising
author: Odile Villalobos
blurb: Cyrus Dravenmoor, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
